title: mentha gentilis var. agardhiana
intro: Mentha gentilis var. agardhiana, commonly known as Bergamot Mint, is a plant species within the mint family, characterized by its unique combination of sweet and citrusy scents. The health benefits of Bergamot Mint include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of nausea and headaches. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Bergamot Mint include limonene, linalool, and menthone, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aromatherapeutic benefits.
